title: The Echo Awakens
steps: Obtain a Seedspall Astrum from Yagudo in Meriphataud Mountains, near the Castle Oztroja approach at K-8.
Obtain a Seedspall Luna from Quadav in Pashhow Marshlands, near the Beadeaux approach at K-10.
Obtain a Seedspall Lux from Orcs in Jugner Forest, near the Davoi approach at G-11.
Bring all three physical items to Qufim Island. Trade them together to the ??? at G-6 between the two stone pillars near the H-6 path, then watch the scene.

title: Gatherer of Light (I)
requirements: Access to the raised ledges through Beaucedine Glacier, Crawlers' Nest and Garlaige Citadel.
steps: Defeat Goblins in Batallia Downs until you receive the bowl of bland Goblin salad key item. Reach the raised F-5 ledge through Beaucedine Glacier, examine its ??? and defeat Vegnix Greenthumb for Seedspall Roseum.
Defeat Goblins in Rolanberry Fields for the jug of greasy Goblin juice. Reach the raised D-11 ledge through Crawlers' Nest, examine its ??? and defeat Chuglix Berrypaws for Seedspall Caerulum.
Defeat Goblins in Sauromugue Champaign for the chunk of smoked Goblin grub. Reach the I-9/J-10 cliff through Garlaige Citadel, examine its ??? and defeat Dribblix Greasemaw for Seedspall Viridis.
Each participant seeking credit must hold the corresponding food key item when that NM dies. After obtaining all three seedspall key items, return to the Qufim G-6 ??? for the scene.

title: Gatherer of Light (II)
steps: Prepare beside the same G-6 ??? with the participating party nearby, then examine it again to start the confrontation.
Defeat all 30 Seed Mandragoras within the 30-minute field battle. Keep the fight inside the encounter area and do not zone away.
After victory, examine the ??? again for the concluding scene. Confirm that Those Who Lurk in Shadows (I) is active.
notes: If the fight fails, recollect the three Goblin NM seedspall key items before trying again.
The reference confrontation dismisses Trusts on entry; Zenith behavior is not confirmed.

title: Those Who Lurk in Shadows (II)
requirements: Sneak/Invisibility supplies and a route through both floors recommended.
steps: Search both floors of Fei'Yin for the nine differently colored Seed Afterglows. Examine all nine within 30 minutes; their positions can move, so use the route maps and check nearby rooms.
The required colors are red, orange, yellow, green, cerulean, blue, golden, silver and white. Keep track of colors received in your key items.
At the reward choice, select the Mark of Seed to continue the story. The Azure key is an alternative reward and does not replace the battlefield entry item.
If the timer expires, leave Fei'Yin and re-enter to restart the search. Take the Mark of Seed to the Burning Circle in Qu'Bia Arena.
reward: Mark of Seed for the next battlefield.

title: Those Who Lurk in Shadows (III)
requirements: Mark of Seed for each character requiring mission credit.
steps: Examine the Burning Circle for the opening scene, then examine it again to select the mission battlefield.
Enter with your Mark of Seed and defeat the four Seed beastmen: Orc, Quadav, Yagudo and Goblin. Coordinate crowd control and concentrate damage on one target at a time.
Watch the post-battle scene. Your next story destination is the Hall of the Gods.

title: Banishing the Echo
requirements: Travel supplies usable under a level-30 restriction.
steps: Examine the Seed Fragment near the entrance to accept the level-30 restriction and start the ascent. Prepare Sneak/Invisibility consumables before accepting it.
Collect the Seed Afterglow on every floor. Lower tower: floor 1 J-11 Amicitia; floor 2 H-7 Veritas; floor 3 I-9 Sapientia.
Middle tower: floor 4 H-10 Sanctitas; floor 5 G-7 Felicitas; floor 6 F-8 Divitia; floor 7 H-9 Studium; floor 8 I-8 Amoris; floor 9 G-8 Caritas.
Upper tower: floor 10 G-9 Constantia; floor 11 H-7 Spei; floor 12 H-7 Salus. Follow the stairs through every floor rather than skipping the required afterglows.
At the Stellar Fulcrum, examine the Seed Fragment with all twelve key items to receive the Omnis Stone. Examine the Qe'Iov Gate for the scene leading to the final battle.

title: Ode of Life Bestowing
requirements: A prepared level-75 party is recommended; Zenith Trust entry and solo balance are unconfirmed.
steps: Examine the Qe'Iov Gate with an Omnis Stone and choose Ode of Life Bestowing. The reference battlefield allows six participants and lasts 30 minutes.
Defeat the Seed Crystal while handling its summoned Seed Thralls. Establish a tank, healing coverage and an add-control role before entering.
Complete the victory scene and retain the Prismatic key for your armor reward in Lower Jeuno.
reward: Prismatic key, Ebon key; title: Silencer of the Echo.

title: A Crystalline Prophecy (Fin.)
requirements: Prismatic key from the final battlefield.
steps: Go to the Tenshodo headquarters inside Neptune's Spire at J-8 and examine the Treasure Coffer.
Use the Prismatic key reward choice to select one body: Nuevo Coselete, Mirke Wardecors or Royal Redingote. Review the two augment selections before confirming.
Fin. is the completed storyline marker. It can remain in the mission log; there is no additional story objective to clear.
reward: One selected, augmented add-on body armor.
